KEY pricing mechanics: (1) Seed text models use TIERED-by-INPUT-LENGTH pricing — three context bands 0-32K / 32K-128K / 128K-256K, with the WHOLE request priced by which band the input falls in. (2) Prompt caching is transparent: a "cache-hit" input rate (~20% of input) plus a cache-storage fee (0.017 元/百万tokens/小时 on 2.1). (3) Batch/offline inference is ~50% of online. (4) A 1.6/某些 "特惠区" discount applies for input≤32K & output≤200 tokens (output drops to 2 元/M). (5) Image = per-image (元/张). (6) Video = per-MILLION-TOKENS where tokens are estimated from resolution×framerate×duration; a Draft/样片 mode applies a discount coefficient (Seedance 1.5 pro: 0.7 silent / 0.6 audio). (7) Audio TTS/ASR sold via 字数包/时长包/并发包 (resource packages) + token billing on newest end-to-end models, NOT a single list rate.

UNCERTAINTY / GAPS: Exact model-id date-suffixes for 2.1 (doubao-seed-2-1-pro-260628 / -turbo-260628) and 2.0 (doubao-seed-2-0-*-260215) come from launch reports, not confirmed on a live console page; the trailing date suffix may vary by release. The full 32K-128K / 128K-256K tier table for Seed-2.1 was NOT found verbatim (only the ≤32K headline 6/30 Pro, 3/15 Turbo + cache-hit 1.2/0.6 confirmed); I have NOT invented the higher tiers for 2.1. Seedance per-resolution paramMatrix is computed by formula (no flat per-clip list price exists). Embedding output is not separately charged (input-only). Audio per-character list rates were not published as a single number; resource-package figures (TTS 音色 150元/年, ASR file 0.8元/小时 / streaming 1.0元/小时, concurrency packs) are given instead.
